dogecoin.text: @dogecoin_rise I’m not an expert, but in the short period of time that I have been trading, I’ve learned one thing, stay calm! don’t panic! If you panic, you make wrong decisions and that’s when you’ll actually lose money! Definitely keep your coins, specially if you are already under.

@dogecoin_rise looking at the replies, no one knows. We can’t even predict the weather right, but don’t lose any hope and hold. It is normal to start fearing when numbers start to drop, but remember how you feel every time the numbers go up! What a rush, exciting!
